narrative.northStar: Letters are places, and places are stars.
narrative.overview:
The established constellation metaphor remains: letters locate stickers, traces connect those places, and the exact engine-driven cube is the hero. Recursive stays the only type family. The September 17 approval extends the room around that work with selectable colourways and scenery; it does not replace the teaching interface or invent a new identity.

Reading and operating surfaces remain opaque and legible. Visitors can choose light or dark independently from a colourway, a semantic sticker palette, a scene and a comfortable or compact layout. The six-step site guide is an optional, replayable route into the existing product, not a prerequisite for using it.

Decoration is still until an action changes it. One canvas reacts to scroll, settings, resize and bounded navigation travel; reduced motion makes the scene static. No uploaded reference imagery, copied visual assets, new network dependency or idle animation loop is required.
keyCharacteristics: Exact cubes and semantic face-coloured letters remain the spatial anchors.
Six interface colourways have independent light and dark tones.
Opaque work surfaces separate foreground contrast from optional scenery.
Compact density preserves important control and sticker target sizes.
A saved, replayable guide uses native modal and keyboard behaviour.

rules.name: The Face Meaning Rule
rules.body: A sticker colour means its face. Interface accents decorate the room; they never redefine faces or become correctness, track or mastery codes.

rules.name: The Opaque Work Surface Rule
rules.body: Reading, controls and cube work live on opaque ground-based surfaces; do not claim the old single-star contrast bound for the new composited scenery.

rules.name: The Action-Bounded Scene Rule
rules.body: Scenery responds to deliberate actions, never elapsed idle time. Navigation may schedule frames for at most 360ms; reduced motion eliminates scene travel and scroll movement.

rules.name: The Native Choice Rule
rules.body: Colourway and scene choices are native labelled radios with an outline and visible Selected text. Pending persistence disables the group; a failure preserves the previous choice and offers retry.

dos: Do keep interface colourway, light/dark tone, semantic sticker palette and scenery independent.
Do retain the exact engine cube, Recursive role hierarchy, semantic face colours and text cube alternative.
Do keep work surfaces opaque, controls keyboard-operable and important touch targets at least 44px.
Do preserve a saved guide cursor, Previous/Next/restart, Escape and explicit return focus.
Do reduce scene cost using available device hints and stop navigation frames when their bounded travel ends.
Do distinguish implemented code, correction captures and pending reviewer or physical-device evidence.
donts: Don't use interface accents to encode cube faces, correctness, tracks or mastery.
Don't add idle RAF, per-particle DOM nodes, looping weather, autoplay decoration or section slide-up entrances.
Don't shrink buttons or sticker targets to achieve compact density.
Don't apply transform-based dialog entrances that displace guide controls during hit-testing.
Don't present an image comp, concept seed, font workaround or iOS approval that was never established.
Don't infer physical-cube or real-device verification from emulated browser tests.
